author: advance_point_geometry
claim: Actual normalized source generic dt frame and exact original signed-root cotangent coefficients on the same proper normal-model source; integral-center comparison remains open.

obligations.name: Exact source and base
obligations.required_input: Use the same normal-model SourceOpenRing and arithmetic localization, not a replacement smooth curve.
obligations.constructed_input: IntegralNormalSourceDifferentialFrame318 uses precisely IntegralDistinctContactOpen318.Base/OpenOrder and the same denominator.
obligations.justification: The normal-model source in Realization is definitionally this ring; no root order or twist normalization is changed.

obligations.name: Etale hypotheses
obligations.required_input: The differential base-change equivalence requires formally etale maps, not a rank claim.
obligations.constructed_input: Base is Localization.Away of its original polynomial denominator; finite_free_etale supplies the four-root order etale instance.
obligations.justification: Both maps are actual original algebra maps. The construction makes no claim about excluded closed fibers.

obligations.name: Normalization
obligations.required_input: A dt frame must send the actual original coordinate differential to one.
obligations.constructed_input: frame_D uses the polynomial derivative equivalence and both exact formally-etale differential maps.
obligations.justification: No unspecified unit scalar is suppressed.

obligations.name: Original point
obligations.required_input: The scalar extension must use the same original signed point and base coefficient map.
obligations.constructed_input: Local point algebra is M.fieldPoint.toAlgebra; field_scalar derives its base action and original_coordinate derives its t value.
obligations.justification: Both are obtained from M.field_polynomial, not from a new point or evaluation postulate.

obligations.name: Actual generic cotangent
obligations.required_input: Avoid replacing the geometric cotangent with Omega(K/V).
obligations.constructed_input: Fiber is K tensor over SourceOpenRing with Omega(SourceOpenRing/V), with an explicit K-linear equivalence.
obligations.justification: frame_dt and unique_dt_coefficient establish the exact distinguished nonzero direction.

obligations.name: Root identity and signs
obligations.required_input: Differentiate all four actual quadratic relations with original coefficient and root index.
obligations.constructed_input: root_square and root_differential cover Fin4; normalized_root_relation uses M.field_roots for the same index.
obligations.justification: The undivided identity holds before any division; no sign quotient or guessed branch parameters.

obligations.name: Undo normalization
obligations.required_input: Returning to original roots must retain the exact multiplier and original twist.
obligations.constructed_input: originalRootDifferential is D.multiplier times the actual normalized differential; original_signed_root_relation uses D.original_signed_root and original_coefficient.
obligations.justification: The two powers of the multiplier are tracked explicitly; original_signed_root_coefficient derives its denominator nonzero from the twist unit.

obligations.name: Consumer and remaining comparison
obligations.required_input: A generic source frame alone does not identify the integral center image or a Hodge lattice.
obligations.constructed_input: same_normal_center retains exact M.center_generic; previous center-image producer remains unchanged.
obligations.justification: No comparison of cotangents across actual affine chart/stalk maps is assumed. This remains the next missing connection.

obligations.name: History and verification
obligations.required_input: Preserve previous arguments and distinguish source construction from kernel/full-theorem acceptance.
obligations.constructed_input: 1415 predecessor modules exact; three new sources and pinned primary files; no local Lean.
obligations.justification: Prior ContactUnbranchedDifferentialFrame318 provides the same etale-frame method over Q, read and adapted to this actual V source. Bad-prime regularity and Hodge/KS/metric claims remain open.
